newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tasmanian mineral sands mine set to commence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tasmanian mineral sands mine set to commence.

text.p: Site work is set to commence this month on a mineral sands mining development project on King Island, Tasmania, Tasmanian mines minister John Beswick said on Wednesday.
Work is to be conducted by unlisted Australian Titanium Minerals Ltd of Queensland, which initially will invest A$10 million over 12 months on the project, he said in a statement.

The region of the island to be mined, Naracoopa, is rich in zircon, rutile, ilmenite and leucoxene, the statement said. These minerals are used in the manufacture of ceramics, paints, chemicals and other materials.

Italian ceramic tile manufacturer Emilceramica, which has a small shareholding in Australian Titanium, has signed a long-term agreement to purchase all zircon produced at the mine, the statement said.
